preconditions.description: The board size n is an integer between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(p) == n and sorted(p) == list(range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: The input list p contains exactly n integers which form a permutation of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (len(output_lines) == n and all(len(output_lines[i]) == i + 1 for i in range(n)))
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output consists of n lines where the i-th line (0-indexed) contains exactly i+1 integers; otherwise, the output is the single string '-1'.

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' and all(all(1 <= val <= n for val in output_lines[i]) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If a solution is provided, every cell in the output grid contains an integer between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' and all(output_lines[i][i] == p[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For every row i, the value on the main diagonal (column i) matches the input permutation value p[i].

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' and all(sum(1 for r in range(n) for c in range(r + 1) if output_lines[r][c] == k) == k for k in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For every region label k, the total count of cells assigned to region k in the lower triangle (including diagonal) is exactly k.

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' and all(all((r, c) in region_cells[k] for k in range(1, n + 1) for (r, c) in region_cells[k]) and all(any(abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 1 for (r2, c2) in region_cells[k]) for (r1, c1) in region_cells[k] if len(region_cells[k]) > 1) for k in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: For every region k, the set of cells assigned to k forms a single connected component where adjacent cells share an edge (up, down, left, right).

postconditions.expression: output != '-1' and all((i, i) in region_cells[p[i]] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: For every row i, the cell (i, i) on the main diagonal belongs to the region labeled p[i].
